title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Relationships support At Embrace, we offer specialised assessments for participants with complex or unclear needs. These assessments help determine the type of long-term or intensive support needed to address challenging behaviours. Our services include Behaviour Management Plan For participants experiencing challenges with their behaviour or social interactions, we provide a culturally safe tailored behaviour management plan to address their specific needs and enhance their quality of life. At Embrace, we focus on proactive strategies to prevent and appropriately manage challenging behaviour, including identifying triggers, fostering suitable learning environments, enhancing communication skills, establishing routines, and setting clear boundaries. Additionally, our plan incorporates reactive strategies to guide carers in responding to disruptive behaviour effectively, such as reminders, distractions, and trigger removal. Individual Social Skills Development At Embrace, our NDIS Improved Relationships service focuses on enhancing social skills for individuals. Our goal is to help them develop and practice effective communication and social interaction skills, fostering their participation in community activities. Through our support, individuals learn verbal and nonverbal communication techniques, including body language and eye contact. We also teach essential social skills like effective communication, active listening, empathy, conflict resolution, respect, and relationship building. Our services include individual and group learning opportunities, assistance in engaging in community activities, and learning time management skills. Activity Based Transport At Embrace, we offer Activity Based Transport services as part of our commitment to support community participation. This service provides transportation to and from community activities, with our team also providing support at the destination. We also provide General Transport Services for activities not classified as support, such as trips to locations where services are provided by other providers or where no support is being delivered. Our aim is to ensure seamless transportation arrangements for our clients, facilitating their access to various activities and services.
